Portfolio contents
The website contains a home page, a Quarto CEP dashboard, a CSS/SCSS explanation with applied examples, and a working Quarto project listing. QMD source, configuration, styles, and planning data are included in the repository.
The CEP dashboard summarizes the Kellogg Ranch research plan and my website-usability objective. It distinguishes planning targets from observed results; no participant data or performance results were supplied.

Approach
This M10 project combines a shared website configuration, QMD source documents, a static R-powered dashboard, a reusable SCSS theme, responsive CSS, and generated project listings. The main navigation offers four clear destinations. Downloadable CSV files make the dashboard’s planning inputs inspectable.

title: Share analysis through a Quarto portfolio
text:
What this demonstrates
A single source of truth reduces inconsistent numbers and duplicated presentation work. The dashboard derives its counts from local data, while the listing derives cards from document metadata. Readers can navigate the rendered output; source files remain available for review and reuse.

title: Find a project
text:
Quarto listings in this portfolio
A Quarto listing automatically organizes documents into a collection of cards, a table, or a list. This page uses a grid to bring together my CEP, analytics, and communication projects.
Each card draws its title, description, date, and categories from the project document’s metadata. Search, category filters, and sorting help readers find relevant work. When project documents are added or updated, the collection reflects those changes after the website is rendered.
The listing is connected to the projects/ folder:
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort-ui: true
This approach keeps the portfolio organized without manually maintaining every project link.

title: Home
text:
About me
Through my work at Cal Poly Pomona, I am developing a foundation in survey research, SQL, BigQuery, R, and reproducible reporting with Quarto. In my Culminating Experience Project (CEP), I contribute to a digital marketing strategy for The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch. My focus is website content, navigation, and usability: helping prospective guests find dining information and reach the reservation interface.

title: CSS & SCSS
text:
CSS controls the appearance of a webpage, including its colors, typography, spacing, and layout. SCSS extends CSS with variables and nesting; Quarto compiles it into CSS when the site is rendered.
This portfolio uses a deep green palette, warm accents, and a neutral background. Shared styles keep the home page, project summaries, and dashboard visually connected.

title: CSS & SCSS
text:
A shared theme
The website configuration connects the built-in theme to my custom files:
format:
  html:
    theme: [cosmo, theme.scss]
    css: styles.css
In theme.scss, variables such as $primary define consistent colors. The scss:defaults section sets theme variables, and scss:rules contains custom component styles. In styles.css, class selectors control elements such as the profile photo and project panels.

Consistent design: This panel uses a reusable SCSS class for its accent border, background, and spacing.

title: Make dining information easier to find
text:
My contribution
In the Group 9 CEP report, I am responsible for AO4, website content, navigation, and usability. The plan combines unassisted task-completion rates, median successful completion times, five-point ease ratings, and qualitative observations. Each task is compared with a proposed 80% completion target.

title: Make dining information easier to find
text:
What this demonstrates
The work links an operational question to observable behavior and defined measures. It also separates reaching the reservation interface from making a reservation, keeping recommendations within the evidence the study can provide.

Approach
My earlier IBM 6500 portfolio brings together Introduction to SQL, Introduction to BigQuery, and Intermediate SQL learning notes and course-completion evidence. The examples connect database querying with marketing research questions.

title: Turn customer questions into database queries
text:
What this demonstrates
SQL provides a reproducible way to select relevant records, summarize observations, and connect related tables. Clear filters and denominators matter because a syntactically correct query can still answer the wrong business question. Before interpreting an aggregate, I need to understand the unit of analysis and check for duplicate rows and missing values.
